overall_notes: This paper analyzes the gap between real-world user queries to LLMs and traditional NLP benchmarks. While it studies NLG tasks prevalent in user interactions, it does not evaluate generated outputs with automatic metrics or LLM judges. The human evaluation focuses on verifying annotation quality rather than assessing generation quality.
